BrokenRegion.description:
Where the part is broken. ``kind="outline"``: a piece of the top-view outline is missing (``polygon_mm`` is the
completed outline or the missing patch, part frame). ``kind="height"``: the top of the part is missing, so the side
photo shows it shorter than it was; code takes the break height from the side measurement and leaves everything
above it out of the side and walk-around comparisons (``polygon_mm`` stays empty).
BrokenRegion.title: BrokenRegion

BuyLookup.description: The search half of the card. `mode` "mock" means no search ran and nothing here came from the web.
BuyLookup.title: BuyLookup

BuyOrPrint.description: One card per job (or published part). Building it never touches the verification: `status` is copied from it.
BuyOrPrint.title: BuyOrPrint

CitedOffer.description:
A price for the original part. Code keeps it only with an http(s) URL the search returned and a quote that
contains the price.
CitedOffer.title: CitedOffer

CitedPlace.description: A nearby print shop, repair café or maker space, kept only with a cited URL and quote.
CitedPlace.title: CitedPlace

DataOrigin.description: Provenance of an input or run. Synthetic and mock data are always labelled as such.
DataOrigin.title: DataOrigin

FitCheckResult.description:
Screen fit check: the real part photographed lying on the model's 1:1 outline (docs/API.md).

`hausdorff_mm` and `mean_mm` are null when the photo could not be compared with the outline at all (no mat markers
found, or no part found on the outline); `passed` is then false, `iou` is 0 and `reasons` says what to retake.
FitCheckResult.title: FitCheckResult

FocusEvent.description: The agent points the viewer at a feature or location (part frame, mm).
FocusEvent.title: FocusEvent

MateFit.description: One measured mate against the model's matching feature. Informational: it never sets `verified`.
MateFit.title: MateFit

MateFitResult.description: mate_fit.json: the mating photo's measured mates and how the model fits them (code only).
MateFitResult.title: MateFitResult

MateMeasurement.description:
One mating feature measured on the "where it fits" photo (same mat, same metrology as the top view).

mate_hole: a socket or bore the part goes INTO (its diameter); mate_peg: a shaft or pin the part goes ONTO (its
diameter; a shaft lying on its side is read from its width with the round-section parallax removed); mate_slot: a
slot (opening) or a panel edge (material) the part clips into or onto (its width). The pixel comes from the user's
tap or from a model pointing at the photo; the size always comes from code.
MateMeasurement.title: MateMeasurement

Measurements.description:
Everything the metrology stage measured from one view, in the PART frame
(centre of min-area rect, long side +X, Y up), millimetres.
Measurements.title: Measurements

OemPart.description: The original part as a cited page names it.
OemPart.title: OemPart

ParamSpec.description: One knob in a part program's PARAMS block: name: (default, min, max, step, unit, affects_fit, label).
ParamSpec.title: ParamSpec

Passport.description: `GET /passport/{id}`: what a printed passport id points at, and how to reprint it.
Passport.title: Passport

PassportCheck.description: One re-measurement after the passport id was debossed (before / after; any change undoes the mark).
PassportCheck.title: PassportCheck

PassportLink.description: The passport id as shown on a part page or a job (copy link, QR downloads).
PassportLink.title: PassportLink

PassportMark.description:
What happened when a bake asked for `passport=1`. Code decides; `applied` is false whenever no safe face
existed or a re-measurement changed.
PassportMark.title: PassportMark

PrintEstimate.description:
Code's numbers for one material. Grams are the solid volume times the density (100 % infill), an upper
bound; minutes and costs are labelled estimates (`assumptions` lists every constant used).
PrintEstimate.title: PrintEstimate

PrintedFit.description:
The same fit after printing on one printer + material preset. Internal fits (a hole or gap in the model)
print about the preset's clearance small on FDM; outer sizes print as modelled and no preset changes them.
PrintedFit.title: PrintedFit

Source.description: Where a value came from. Shown on every number in the UI and exports.
Source.title: Source

ThoughtEvent.description: A model's reasoning summary (never raw chain of thought), shown in the trace.
ThoughtEvent.title: ThoughtEvent

ToolCallEvent.description: One tool call made by an agentic model stage; the result summary is what code returned.
ToolCallEvent.title: ToolCallEvent

UncheckedValue.description:
A dimension of the final model (a PARAMS knob) that no measured or user-stated value was tested against.

It comes from the program (a template default or a value inferred from the measured ones), so it is labelled
inferred and NOT verified, whatever the part's status. The silhouette comparison only covers it as far as it
changes a compared view's outline (`note` says which views were compared). A dimension the user stated because the
photo cannot show it (the original length of a broken part) is listed with source `user_stated`: stated, not
observed, so it is NOT verified either.
UncheckedValue.title: UncheckedValue
